paper_title: A Spectroscopic Search for Optical Emission Lines from Dark Matter Decay
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted by me from the paper's decay-rate limit Gamma < 3.3e-26 s^-1 using Gamma = g^2 m^3 / (64 pi) in natural units (hbar = 6.582e-16 eV s)
notes: DESI stacked dark-sky spectroscopy search for monoenergetic optical lines from two-photon dark matter decay at ~50 kpc impact parameter around BGS/LRG galaxies. Paper's primary result (Fig. 8) is a 5-sigma limit on the two-photon decay rate Gamma vs mass over 5-12 eV (from 2000-9000 A wavelength range; full search covers 2.8-12.4 eV but tightest above 5 eV). Headline limit: lifetime > 3e25 s (Gamma < ~3.3e-26 s^-1) treated here as approximately flat over 5-12 eV; the actual curves in Fig. 8 vary between ~1e-26 and ~1e-25 s^-1 and machine-readable data are on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.8339781). Values emitted are g_agamma converted from Gamma via the ALP relation quoted in the paper. Stated confidence: 5-sigma detection limit (more conservative than 95% CL; reported here as 0.95 since schema requires 0.90/0.95). No local DM density assumption; surface mass density from SDSS/CMASS weak lensing (~30% systematic uncertainty).
